source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

unique_apps  <- sort(unique(raw_data$app_name))

plots <- map(unique_apps, function(app) {
  file_data <- raw_data %>%
    filter(app_name == app)

  if (nrow(file_data) == 0) {
    return(
      htmltools::tags$div(
        
        htmltools::tags$div(
          style = "width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 20px; color: #999; font-family: Consolas; font-size: 12px;",
          paste0("No data available for: ", app)
        )
      )
    )
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 1. COLOR PALETTE ASSIGNMENT
  # ============================================================
  all_unique_labels  <- sort(unique(file_data$label))
  set.seed(42)
  transaction_colors <- setNames(choose_palette(length(all_unique_labels)), all_unique_labels)

  # ============================================================
  # 2. SAMPLE + PREPARE SCATTER DATA
  # ============================================================
  scatter_data <- file_data %>%
    group_by(run_id) %>%
    sample_n(size = min(n(), 20000)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      label          = factor(label, levels = all_unique_labels),
      formatted_time = format(timestamp, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    )

  # ============================================================
  # 3. BUILD GGPLOT
  # ============================================================
  p <- ggplot(
    scatter_data,
    aes(
      x    = timestamp,
      y    = elapsed,
      fill = label,
      text = paste0(
        "Business Flow: ",   thread_group,
        "\nRun ID: ",        run_id,
        "\nTransaction: ",   label,
        "\nApplication: ",   app,
        "\nTime: ",          formatted_time,
        "\nResponse Time: ", round(elapsed, 0), " ms"
      )
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      shape  = 21,
      color  = "#222222",
      stroke = 0.2,
      alpha  = 0.5,
      size   = 2
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = transaction_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = "Timeline Log",
      y = "Response Time (ms)"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~run_id, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.spacing   = rel(2),
      axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, family = "Consolas", size = 10),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 10),
      axis.title.x    = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333", margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333", margin = margin(r = 20)),
      strip.text      = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 11, color = "#333", face = "bold")
    )

  # ============================================================
  # 4. CONVERT TO PLOTLY + WebGL
  # ============================================================
  pl <- ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text", height = 550) %>%
    toWebGL()

  # ============================================================
  # 5. LAYOUT CONFIG
  # ============================================================
  layout_config <- list(
    showlegend = TRUE,
    margin     = list(l = 100, r = 40, b = 80, t = 80),
    dragmode   = FALSE,
    hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "white"),
    height     = 550,
    width      = NULL,
    title      = list(
      text    = paste0(
        "<b>Response Time Scatter:</b> ", app
      ),
      x       = 0,
      xanchor = "left",
      font    = list(size = 14, family = "Consolas", color = "#333")
    )
  )

  for (i in 1:10) {
    x_name <- if (i == 1) "xaxis" else paste0("xaxis", i)
    y_name <- if (i == 1) "yaxis" else paste0("yaxis", i)

    if (i == 1) {
      layout_config[[x_name]]$fixedrange <- TRUE
      layout_config[[y_name]]$fixedrange <- TRUE
      layout_config[[y_name]]$automargin <- TRUE
    } else {
      layout_config[[x_name]] <- list(fixedrange = TRUE)
      layout_config[[y_name]] <- list(fixedrange = TRUE)
    }
  }

  pl <- do.call(layout, c(list(pl), layout_config)) %>%
    plotly::config(
      responsive     = TRUE,
      displayModeBar = TRUE,
      toImageButtonOptions = list(
        format   = "png",
        filename = paste0("Scatter_", app, "_", Sys.Date()),
        height   = 550,
        width    = 1400
      ),
      modeBarButtonsToRemove = list(
        "zoom2d", "pan2d", "select2d", "lasso2d", "zoomIn2d", "zoomOut2d",
        "autoScale2d", "resetScale2d", "hoverClosestCartesian", "hoverCompareCartesian"
      )
    )

  htmltools::tagList(
    
    htmltools::tags$div(
      style = "width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 10px;",
      pl
    ),
    render_observation_panel(
      chart_id = paste0(
        "chart_rawScatterWebGLCsvFilename_",
        app
      )
    )
  )
})

htmltools::tagList(
  Filter(Negate(is.null), plots)
)
